scene: The marked transit routes align with waiting night transports outside the open workshop.
picture: A wide side-scrolling view of Midnight Radio Repair's streetfront bay. On the left, a yellow tow truck hums near the player, a middle-aged Black man in an orange corduroy jacket holding a unfolded route map. At centre stands his sidecar motorbike. To the right waits a glass funicular car beside an idle, multi-legged bridge crawler.
shown: a yellow tow truck idling with flashing orange beacons on the far left
a glass-domed funicular car parked at a sloped rail station on the right
a multi-legged mechanised bridge crawler resting by the kerb on the far right
